title: Linear Issue Inventory
description: Output of 08_extract_linear.py for the issues stream. Records Linear issues, labels, and SLA-relevant fields. May contain an empty `issues` array with `unavailable_reason='no_linear_api_key'` when LINEAR_API_KEY is absent (the no-op path). Consumed by 09_compute_metrics.py for Metrics 6 (Flow Distribution — Linear-label classification) and 12 (Defects Out of SLA). The required core surface is `issues` (array, possibly empty) plus `unavailable_reason` (string or null) so the consumer can detect API availability without coupling to the optional `_metadata` envelope.

category.description: Optional pre-classified category (feature/defect/risk-compliance/tech-debt/unknown) populated by 08_extract_linear.py when label-rules resolve.

unavailable_reason.description: Machine-readable sentinel set by 08_extract_linear.py to communicate API unavailability (e.g., 'no_linear_api_key').
